title: SwyHub Skateboard for Brainroots Auto Farm Upgrade and More
features:

Take your Brainroots progression to the next level with SwyHub — now upgraded with a completely redesigned UI for a cleaner, faster, and more intuitive experience.

• Modern and optimized interface design  
• Improved navigation and usability

🌐 Dashboard Integration:

Track Divine, Celestial, and Secret items in real-time with high-precision scanning. Instantly locate and collect valuable resources across the map.

💹 Profit Optimization:
• Auto-sell system based on custom thresholds

🔄 Anti-AFK System:
Prevents inactivity disconnections by simulating natural interactions, allowing long sessions without interruptions.

SwyHub is actively maintained with continuous improvements, optimizations, UI upgrades, and dashboard integrations to ensure a stable and efficient experience.
